10104.en: Definition (from X_8181): Suppose that T = TaTbTc is a triangle in the plane of ABC that is perspective to ABC. Let P be the perspector. If the circumcenters of PBTc, PCTa, PATb, PCTb, PATc, PBTa lie on a circle, that circle is the T-van Lamoen circle.
